purpose: Produce one reusable, score-blind proof that the complete Wave1 recovery2 evidence exists and that its controller, workers, services, ports, tmux sessions, storage, and successor-root constraints permit the already frozen closure sequence to begin.

covers: active process port or tmux rejection

controller: TERMINAL_ACCEPTED exists and TERMINAL_REJECTED is absent
identity contains the exact recovery2 scheduler and resource change
progress.csv has exactly 12 method-major seed-minor ACCEPTED rows
controller SHA256SUMS signs exactly identity.txt and progress.csv
method_seed_runs: all 12 exact fresh run and aggregate roots exist
every scheduler has SCHEDULER_EXECUTION_ACCEPTED and no rejection marker
every run contains exactly the frozen 150 unit names
all 1800 units are TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and not TERMINAL_REJECTED
every unit SHA256SUMS member is rehashed
every scheduler SHA256SUMS member is rehashed and rejected-units.csv is empty
all 12 aggregate audits report 150 observed of 150 expected, zero failed, 2761 sessions, and 7906 QA
all aggregate audits bind the frozen source commit, dataset manifest, unit inventory, and main-comparison eligibility
every aggregate SHA256SUMS member is rehashed

storage.data2_rule: free bytes must be at least all accepted recovery2 source-evidence bytes plus 10737418240 reserve bytes

report_contract.role: release and provenance evidence only; it is not a numerical result

next_gate: After the controller becomes terminal and all WMA processes, services, ports, and tmux sessions have exited, package this exact implementation without modification, run it once with mandatory unit hashes, preserve stdout as an immutable release receipt, and independently verify that receipt before stage-1 postprocessing.
prohibited_actions: running the release audit as proof while the controller is active
skipping unit hashes in an accepted release receipt
reading or reporting numeric score values during release auditing
starting closure model materialization or another numerical method before the accepted release receipt
deleting any accepted rejected or failure evidence or any model from this gate
